description: This file contains a static class 'Slug' with an extension method 'GenerateSlug' that creates URL slugs from input strings by normalizing, trimming, and replacing invalid characters with hyphens.

classes.name: Slug
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to generate URL-friendly slugs from strings.

methods.name: GenerateSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL slug from a given string by converting to lowercase, removing invalid characters, collapsing spaces, truncating, and replacing spaces with hyphens.
